notes: Aggregates only the current closed Nominee Distribution adjustment family. It never infers, calculates, or broadens any neighboring interest or transaction surface. Waits for tax.us.2025.scheduleb.adjustment.nominee to be confirmed closed (attachment-closure). Core v68 (interest-cents): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents, which is the figure the Schedule B Part I attachment's itemized rows add to, so the attachment ties out when a member carries cents. Line 2b (rule.form1040-line2b-rounded) rounds the total once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its closure guard is unchanged.
